dog.description_text:
When Onyx first arrived, he was a very shy boy who needed a little time to feel comfortable. But with love, patience, and the support of his foster family, he has truly come out of his shell!

Today, Onyx is a sweet and bubbly pup with a big personality. He loves playing with his toys and having fun with his foster brother, who looks just like him! These two adorable lookalikes are the perfect playmates and love keeping each other company.

When he’s not busy playing, you can find Onyx following his foster mom around everywhere. He loves being close to his people and is happiest when he knows he’s part of the action.

Onyx has come such a long way, and it’s so heartwarming to see his sweet personality shine. This lovable boy is ready to fill his forever home with cuddles, playful energy, and so much love!

﻿Onyx is approximately 1y 3m 19d old and is fully grown at 11 pounds. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
